formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => (∀ (x3 x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x3 - x4 ∈ x1 → x2.eval ((List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x3)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 = x4)) = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), x3.card = (4 : ℕ) → (∀ (x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), {x6 ∈ x3 | x6 - x5 ∈ x1}.card ≤ (2 : ℕ)) → x2.eval ((List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x6 ∈ x3)) ++ List.ofFn fun (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (∀ x7 ∈ x3, x7 - x6 ∉ x1)) = Bool.false; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => ∃ (x4 : ℕ) (x5 : ℕ), (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x3 x4).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt x3 x5).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone (26 : ℕ) x3 x4 x5; ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x4 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (26 : ℕ) x4 → x2 x4 → ¬x3 x4 → (64 : ℕ) ≤ x4.size)
plain_statement: It is false that: One of 2 statements that together prove: Plane of order 3: inputs x_0..x_12 for points, then y_0..y_12 for lines, line l being {l, l+1, l+3, l+9} mod 13. An incident input sets exactly x_p and y_l true with p on l. A quadrangle input takes 4 points Q, no 3 on a line, sets x true exactly on Q and y true exactly on the lines meeting Q in no point. Every list of AND/OR gates of fan-in at most two, each gate reading only earlier wires, with a wire true on every incident input and false on every quadrangle input has at least 64 gates.
